camel_example: aliyun rds ModifyCollationTimeZone --region cn-hangzhou --Timezone China_Standard_Time --DBInstanceId 'rm-bp15qi0nd1u270000' --Collation Chinese_PRC_CS_AS
description_en: Modifies the character set collation and time zone of system databases on an instance
description_zh: 修改RDS SQL Server系统字符集排序规则和时区
kebab_example: aliyun rds modify-collation-time-zone --db-instance-id rm-bp15qi0nd1u270000 --collation Chinese_PRC_CS_AS --timezone China_Standard_Time --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyCollationTimeZone

parameters.help_en:
The character set collation of the instance. By default, the system does not modify the character set collation of the instance. Valid values:

*   **Chinese_PRC_CI_AS**
*   **Chinese_PRC_CS_AS**
*   **Chinese_PRC_BIN**
*   **Latin1\_General_CI_AS**
*   **Latin1\_General_CS_AS**
*   **SQL_Latin1\_General_CP1\_CI_AS**
*   **SQL_Latin1\_General_CP1\_CS_AS**
*   **Japanese_CI_AS**
*   **Japanese_CS_AS**
*   **Chinese_Taiwan_Stroke_CI_AS**
*   **Chinese_Taiwan_Stroke_CS_AS**

> *   The default character set collation of the instance is **Chinese_PRC_CI_AS**.
> *   You must specify one of the **Collation** and **Timezone** parameters
parameters.help_zh:
系统字符集排序规则，默认为不修改。取值：
* **Chinese_PRC_CI_AS**
* **Chinese_PRC_CS_AS**
* **Chinese_PRC_BIN**
* **Latin1_General_CI_AS**
* **Latin1_General_CS_AS**
* **SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CI_AS**
* **SQL_Latin1_General_CP1_CS_AS**
* **Japanese_CI_AS**
* **Japanese_CS_AS**
* **Chinese_Taiwan_Stroke_CI_AS**
* **Chinese_Taiwan_Stroke_CS_AS**

> - 实例默认的字符集排序规则为**Chinese_PRC_CI_AS**。
> - **Collation**与**Timezone**必须传入至少一个
parameters.name: collation

parameters.help_en:
The time zone of the instance. By default, the system does not modify the time zone.

> *   The default time zone of the instance is **China Standard Time**.
> *   You must specify one of the **Collation** and **Timezone** parameters
parameters.help_zh:
系统时区，默认为不修改。

> - 实例默认的时区为**China Standard Time**。
> - **Collation**与**Timezone**必须传入至少一个
parameters.name: timezone
